name: Book Visibility
description: Adds a block-visibility condition plugin (id "book") that shows/hides blocks based on which core Book the current node belongs to. Controls block visibility only, not book-page access.
project_description: Book Visibility enhances the core Book module by providing a per-book block-visibility condition. It ships a single Condition plugin (id "book") extending ConditionPluginBase that adds a "Book" tab to the core block configuration form, letting site builders restrict a block to render only on pages belonging to selected books. It affects block presentation only and does not restrict who can view book content. Note: the core Book module was deprecated in Drupal 10.3 and its functionality moved to the contrib Book module; use this module only on older setups still relying on core Book.
